title: Ice Totem
description: Let the cold season begin! A retexture for the "totem of undying".
body:
# Ice Totem

A simple yet elegant resource pack that transforms the **Totem of Undying** into a frozen, icy aesthetic. This pack replaces the default totem texture with a beautiful ice-themed design that fits perfectly for winter builds, frozen dimensions, or any player who appreciates a cooler visual.

## Features
- Custom frozen texture for the Totem of Undying
- Maintains the original functionality while enhancing visuals
- Perfect for winter-themed worlds and ice palaces
- Compatible with all Minecraft versions supporting resource packs

Enjoy a frosty twist on this iconic item!
